usage: The SQLite contention probe is a path/process-scanning repository tool whose steps must exchange repository paths, worker modes, and worker arguments as strings. The benchmark harness also has a typed process-boundary environment adapter, and the compiler behavior test intentionally groups independent PHPUnit cases. The negative compiler-fixture test enumerates independent fault mutations in one focused table. The public connection-evidence exception, the framework-free holder example, and the disposable worker rehearsal harness keep documented narrow exceptions for the same reason. The rules disabled for those narrow paths add no actionable signal; critical rules stay enforced elsewhere.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: This behavior test groups independent compiler contract cases so their exact SQL assertions remain in one focused fixture.
This negative fixture test enumerates independent fault mutations in one table so every broken relationship stays comparable against the same valid base state.
The harness environment adapter receives typed process metadata as an array to avoid reintroducing a benchmark-only request object.

These release-certification utilities deliberately pass decoded archive, fixture, changelog and report structures between small validation steps instead of introducing a value object for each shape.
The golden case registry repeats compact builder shapes by design; each case asserts a distinct compiled SQL and ordered binding result.
The release fixture builder writes versioned policy documents from explicit scalar facts; grouping them into an argument object would obscure the fixture content.

This public exception mirrors the normalized connection evidence fields one-for-one as readonly constructor properties; grouping them into a parameter object would change the released evidence contract.
The application-owned holder recipe keeps role and lifecycle reason as validated string labels so the example stays framework-free and matches the library's public surface.
The disposable rehearsal tool reads one bounded environment contract into one typed configuration object; splitting it adds indirection without a behavior or safety benefit.
Rehearsal scenarios intentionally repeat response envelopes and acquisition shapes so each endpoint path stays independently readable and fails in isolation.
